name: PROJECT CARD REPORT
query:
SELECT
    p.proj_name                AS 'PROJECT NAME',
    s.select_sub_system        AS 'SUBSYSTEM NAME',
    pkg.pack_name              AS 'PACKAGE NAME',
    card.ecad_card_name        AS 'CARD NAME',
    item.link_part             AS 'LINK PART',
    item.qty                   AS 'QTY',
    item.position              AS 'POSITION',
    item.symbol                AS 'SYMBOL',
    item.stack                 AS 'STACK',
    item.functionality         AS 'FUNCTIONALITY',
    item.add_option            AS 'ADD OPTION',
    item.part_no               AS 'PART NUMBER',
    item.part_desc             AS 'PART DESCRIPTION',
    item.package_style_save    AS 'PACKAGE STYLE',
    item.number                AS 'NUMBER',
    item.description           AS 'DESCRIPTION',
    item.remarks               AS 'REMARKS',
    item.mount_on_save         AS 'MOUNT',
    cwl.owner                  AS 'CREATED BY',
    DATE(cwl.creation)         AS 'CREATED DATE'
FROM `tabCardwise Component List` AS cwl
LEFT JOIN `tabPROJECT_MASTER` p 
    ON cwl.select_project = p.name
LEFT JOIN `tabPRJ_SUB` s 
    ON cwl.select_sub_system = s.name
LEFT JOIN `tabPROJECT_PACKAGE` pkg 
    ON cwl.select_pack_code = pkg.name
LEFT JOIN `tabPRJ_CARDS` card 
    ON card.pack_code = pkg.pack_code 
LEFT JOIN `tabComponent List Item` item 
    ON item.parent = cwl.name
    AND item.parenttype = 'Cardwise Component List'
ORDER BY 
    p.proj_name, 
    s.select_sub_system, 
    pkg.pack_name, 
    card.ecad_card_name, 
    item.idx;
